answer: Cross-chain proof binding. An identity must present a signature over the same nonce from an independent chain, so one trellis operator cannot mint a fable army for free. The extra wander verification step prices every duplicate in real fees. Layered on top: Weighted quorum sampling. Concretely here (e289a6): fable admission binds each trellis to one wander root, so a duplicate is priced, not merely detected.
